connectors.rawg.key.title: Get your RAWG key
connectors.rawg.key.body:
RAWG is free and only needs a key. It is used to show covers and details of your games.
Press “Open the page”: RAWG opens in a new tab. Create an account or sign in.
Request an API key (you can call the application “Ludiary”).
Copy the key they show you.
Come back to this tab and press “Paste”.
connectors.rawg.error.format: That key does not look right. It must have letters and numbers only, with no spaces or symbols.
connectors.igdb.key.title: Create your Twitch application for IGDB
connectors.igdb.key.body:
IGDB is free, but it asks you to create an application on Twitch. It takes a few minutes.
Press “Open the page”: Twitch opens in a new tab. Sign in with your Twitch account (it needs two-step verification turned on).
Type a unique name, set the OAuth redirect URL to http://localhost, pick any category and press “Create”.
In your list of applications, press “Manage” on the new one.
Copy the “Client ID” and paste it in the first field.
Press “New Secret”, copy the “Client Secret” and paste it in the second field.
connectors.igdb.error.format: One of the two values does not look right. They must have letters and numbers only, with no spaces.

updates.title: Updates
updates.mode.title: Updates
updates.mode.hint: Ludiary checks the project's releases page on GitHub at start-up and every 24 hours.
updates.restartConfirm: Ludiary will restart to install version {version}. Games you have open stay open. Continue?
updates.retryBadConfirm: Version {version} already failed to start on this PC. Try again? If it fails again, Ludiary goes back to the current version by itself.
updates.privacy: To look for updates, Ludiary asks GitHub (api.github.com and github.com) for the latest published version. Only your IP address and the installed version are sent; nothing from your library. Versions are signed and Ludiary checks the signature before installing them.
updates.state.unsupported: This installation does not update itself (development build or unmanaged install).
updates.state.idle: No update check has run yet.
updates.state.availableFailedBefore: A new version is available: {version}, but it already failed to start on this PC.
updates.state.ready: Ready: {version} will be installed the next time you open Ludiary.
updates.state.failed: The update could not be completed.
updates.error.check-failed: Could not check whether a new version exists. It will be tried again later.
updates.error.manifest-invalid: The update did not pass the signature check and was not downloaded.
updates.error.manual-required: This version has to be installed by hand from the releases page.
updates.error.hash-mismatch: The downloaded installer does not match what was signed and was discarded.
updates.error.no-space: There is not enough free space to download the update.
updates.error.not-writable: The installation folder cannot be written to; download the installer by hand.
updates.error.download-failed: The update could not be downloaded.
updates.error.install-interrupted: The installation was interrupted and will be tried again when you open Ludiary.
updates.error.rollback-interrupted: Going back to the previous version was interrupted; it will finish when you open Ludiary.
updates.error.verify-failed: The update did not pass the last check before installing and was discarded.
updates.wizard.title: Updates
updates.wizard.body: By default, Ludiary lets you know when a new signed version is out and you decide whether to install it. It can also install it by itself, or never check. You can change this in Settings > About.

updates.notice.downgraded: You installed an older version than the one you had. If the database is newer, error 14 will appear: restore a backup.
